text.value: When somebody calls you or fills out your form, they have already contacted two other companies. Whoever answers first usually gets the customer — not because they are better, but because they were more responsive. We put something in place that answers every one of them in under a minute, day or night, weekends included, and gets them on your calendar. It runs on top of the software you already pay for. Nothing gets replaced and your staff learns nothing new.

text.label: Text: Someone with a problem right now fills in your…
text.value: Someone with a problem right now fills in your form or leaves a message, and then waits. Most businesses answer in hours. Some answer the next day. By then that person has already called somebody else.

text.label: Text: And you never find out. Nobody writes down the…
text.value: And you never find out. Nobody writes down the customer you did not get, because nobody ever knew that person was interested in the first place. It is the most expensive leak in your business and it is invisible, which is exactly why it never gets fixed.

props.text: This is what happens at 11:40 on a Saturday night.
A form comes in while you are asleep, at a job, or having dinner. Nobody on your team sees it until Monday. By then they have called someone else.

props.caption: An illustration of the exchange, not a customer's real thread. The point is the timing: the reply goes out in under a minute, every time, whether or not anyone is awake.

messages.text: Hi — do you have anything open this week? And roughly what does it run?
Yes, we have openings this week. The price depends on what you need, so let me ask you two quick things and I can give you a real number.
Perfect — that puts you at the low end. I have Thursday at 8am or Friday at 10am. Which is easier?
Thursday works. Thank you — I did not expect an answer tonight.

props.text: Why seconds, and not an hour.

Nobody waits any more. Somebody who needs help right now fills out three forms and hires whoever answers first — not whoever was best. That is the entire contest, and it is decided before your competitor has read their email.
Nights, weekends, holidays, while you are busy with the customer in front of you. The reply does not depend on anyone being free.
The second and third follow-up go out on their own. That is where most of the recovered work comes from.
It installs into your current setup.
